# fmc_sinkhole (Resource)

This resource manages a Sinkhole.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Read operations are supported by any tested FMC version
  - Minimum FMC version for object management (Create/Update/Delete): `10.0`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fmc_sinkhole" "example" {
  name                = "my_sinkhole"
  ipv4_address        = "10.1.1.1"
  ipv6_address        = "2001:db8::1"
  action              = "MONITOR"
  log_connection_type = "SINKHOLE_CNC"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipv4_address` (String) IPv4 address of the Sinkhole.
- `ipv6_address` (String) IPv6 address of the Sinkhole.
- `name` (String) Name of the Sinkhole object.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Action of the Sinkhole. MONITOR redirects traffic to a sinkhole server (Log Connections to Sinkhole). BLOCK redirects traffic to a non-resolving IP address (Block and Log Connections to Sinkhole).
  - Choices: `MONITOR`, `BLOCK`
- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `log_connection_type` (String) Type of infection logged when the action is MONITOR.
  - Choices: `SINKHOLE_CNC`, `SINKHOLE_MALWARE`, `SINKHOLE_PHISHING`, `NONE`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'Sinkhole'.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <domain> is optional. If not provided, `Global` is used implicitly and resource's `domain` attribute is not set.
terraform import fmc_sinkhole.example "<domain>,<id>"
```
